_note: Redacted record of the five live troubleshooting runs executed on 2026-10-23 against real Liara (team workspace), by the deployed product, in RULE-ONLY mode (no LLM: llm_unavailable). Recorded from the run outputs; ids, names, release ids and timestamps are removed or generalised. Used as the evidence behind the 'verified live' claims in README.md and docs/. Not used by tests as input.

environment.plan: small-g2 (0.5 vCPU / 0.5 GB) + basic bundle, private network, no disk on the demo app
environment.appletsEndpoint: HTTP 500 from Liara for every app tried (Liara-side); the product degraded as designed

diagnosis.topHypothesis: required environment variable SESSION_SECRET is not defined

verificationChecks.name: applets_available
verificationChecks.note: instance list unavailable (Liara 500); remaining signals used

verificationChecks.name: app_running
verificationChecks.note: via app detail: status ACTIVE, scale 1, deployed, release READY

verificationChecks.name: restart_observed
verificationChecks.note: via Liara events: a container start event after the change

verificationChecks.name: behavior_changed
verificationChecks.note: 500 before the change, 2xx after; never replaces a required check

verificationChecks.name: error_signature_absent
verificationChecks.note: judged on 7 log lines of the NEW release; 7 lines of the previous release ignored (one carried the old error)

history: run 1: not_verified - app status string ACTIVE not recognised, probe/log checks dropped (fixed)
run 2: not_verified - first probe hit the old container during Liara's rolling restart (settling window added)
run 3: not_verified - one old-container error line fell in the same second as the restart event (attribution by release id added)

runs.symptom: GET / -> 502; app logs 'Server listening on port 8080'; platform expects 3000

diagnosis.topHypothesis: app is not reachable on the expected port (current release)
evidence: port_mismatch from the current release's own log line

runs.earlierDefect: before release scoping the diagnosis was 'SESSION_SECRET not set' taken from a previous release's log lines

runs.symptom: process crashes on request, container restarted repeatedly

diagnosis.topHypothesis: application error after the current release
evidence: TypeError with file:line from runtime logs
container die+start x5 within 60 s from Liara events

runs.symptom: newest release FAILED while an older release still serves

diagnosis.topHypothesis: build of the newest release failed; the app still serves the previous release
evidence: npm error code ETARGET: no matching version for express@^99.0.0 (page 2 of the paginated build log, ANSI-coloured STDOUT)

runs.earlierDefect: build log was read only for its first 20 lines, so the error was invisible; stale crash errors from older releases ranked first

runs.symptom: GET /report blocks the event loop for ~3 s; probe timeouts

evidence: CPU 0.496 cores = 99% of the 0.5 vCPU plan, peak 100%, 9 of 12 samples >= 60%
diagnosis.proposal: none (a restart or more RAM would not help)

runs.earlierDefect: first live run produced a weak 'transient or unknown' hypothesis with a restart proposal (thresholds were too strict, weak evidence still carried a state-changing proposal)
